datasets.name: runs
datasets.query: SELECT r.run_key, r.run_id, r.provider, r.backend, r.mode, r.corpus, r.created_at, r.goal_sig_scheme, r.trace_mcts, r.rel_run_dir, r.problem_space, (SELECT count(*) FROM run_files f WHERE f.run_key = r.run_key) AS file_count FROM runs r JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) ORDER BY r.created_at NULLS LAST, r.run_key

datasets.name: run_files
datasets.query: SELECT f.* FROM run_files f JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) ORDER BY f.run_key, f.file_name

datasets.name: theorem_wild
datasets.query: SELECT w.* FROM theorem_wild w JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) ORDER BY w.run_key, w.theorem

datasets.name: theorem_intervention
datasets.query: SELECT i.* FROM theorem_intervention i JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) ORDER BY i.run_key, i.theorem, i.intervention

datasets.name: extract_errors
datasets.query: SELECT e.* FROM extract_errors e JOIN selected_runs s USING(run_key) ORDER BY e.recorded_at
